pages.text: Your first expedition can follow a complete loop: find a ruin, defeat a remnant, collect its core and seal, restore it, and return home. Ancient cores are separate from the Broken Slime Blocks used to revive owned companions.

Hold a damaged core and right-click a $(item)Slime Restoration Station$(). Keep one seal and one slimeball in your inventory. They are consumed and the core becomes a summon item. Find an intact station in ruins or cut Chiseled Slimic Stone Bricks with a stonecutter. Cracked stations do not work.

Guards become $(l:companions/royal_guard)Royal Guards$(), carriers become $(l:companions/transport)Transports$(), and commanders become $(l:companions/commander)Commanders$(). Each receives a new identity and your ownership, and starts waiting at one health. The usual group-wide Commander spawn limit still applies.

Ancient names, purple insignia, and some Endurance training remain. Each core can be restored once across the saved world. Alternatively, combine a Combat Slime with a seal to retain your existing companion’s growth, equipment, and cargo.
